questions.question: From 2010 to 2015, what was the average overall rating of players who are higher than 170?
questions.evidence: from 2010 to 2015 refers to strftime('%Y', fld004) >= '2010' AND <= '2015'; average overall rating = SUM(t2.fld005)/ COUNT(t2.fld001); higher than 170 refers to tab02.fld045 > 170;
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.fld005) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2.fld001) FROM tab02 AS t1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS t2 ON t1.fld003 = t2.fld003 WHERE t1.fld045 > 170 AND STRFTIME('%Y', t2.fld004) >= '2010' AND STRFTIME('%Y', t2.fld004) <= '2015'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.overall_rating) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2.id) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.height > 170 AND STRFTIME('%Y',t2.`date`) >= '2010' AND STRFTIME('%Y',t2.`date`) <= '2015'

questions.question: Tell the build Up play passing class for "FC Lorient" on 2010/2/22.

questions.SQL: SELECT t2.fld058 FROM tab05 AS t1 INNER JOIN tab06 AS t2 ON t1.fld049 = t2.fld049 WHERE t1.fld051 = 'FC Lorient' AND t2.fld004 LIKE '2010-02-22%'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT t2.buildUpPlayPassingClass FROM Team AS t1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t1.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND t2.`date` LIKE '2010-02-22%'

questions.question:
What is the difference of the average ball control score between Abdou Diallo and Aaron Appindangoye
?
questions.evidence: difference of the average ball control = SUBTRACT(AVG(fld019 WHERE fld043 = 'Abdou Diallo'), AVG(fld019 WHERE fld043 = 'Aaron Appindangoye')); AVG(fld019 WHERE fld043 = 'XX XX') = SUM(CASE WHEN fld043 = 'XX XX' THEN fld019 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN fld043 = 'XX XX' THEN id ELSE NULL END)
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.fld043 = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN t2.fld019 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.fld043 = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN t2.fld001 ELSE NULL END) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.fld043 = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN t2.fld019 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.fld043 = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN t2.fld001 ELSE NULL END) FROM tab02 AS t1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS t2 ON t1.fld003 = t2.fld003
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN t2.ball_control ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN t2.id ELSE NULL END) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN t2.ball_control ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN t2.id ELSE NULL END) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id

questions.question: Please provide the full name of the away team that scored the most goals.
questions.evidence: full name refers to fld051; away team refers to fld079; scored the most goals refers to MAX(fld081)
questions.SQL: SELECT t2.fld051 FROM tab07 AS t1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS t2 ON t1.fld079 = t2.fld049 ORDER BY t1.fld081 DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT t2.team_long_name FROM Match AS t1 INNER JOIN Team AS t2 ON t1.away_team_api_id = t2.team_api_id ORDER BY t1.away_team_goal DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which player is older, Aaron Lennon or Abdelaziz Barrada?
questions.evidence: The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa;
questions.SQL: SELECT fld043 FROM tab02 WHERE fld043 IN ('Aaron Lennon', 'Abdelaziz Barrada') ORDER BY fld044 ASC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE player_name IN ('Aaron Lennon', 'Abdelaziz Barrada') ORDER BY birthday ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was the final score for the match on September 24, 2008, in the Belgian Jupiler League between the home team and the away team?
questions.evidence: September 24, 2008 refers to fld004 like '2008-09-24%'; in the Belgian Jupiler League refers to tab03.fld048 = 'Belgium Jupiler League'; final score for home team refers to fld080; final score for away team refers to fld081
questions.SQL: SELECT t2.fld080, t2.fld081 FROM tab03 AS t1 INNER JOIN tab07 AS t2 ON t1.fld001 = t2.fld074 WHERE t1.fld048 = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND t2.fld004 LIKE '2008-09-24%'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT t2.home_team_goal, t2.away_team_goal FROM League AS t1 INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.league_id WHERE t1.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND t2.`date` LIKE '2008-09-24%'

questions.question: When was the first time did Kevin Constant have his highest crossing score? Give the date.
questions.evidence: Kevin Constant refers to fld043 = 'Kevin Constant'; highest crossing score refers to MAX(fld010)
questions.SQL: SELECT fld004 FROM (SELECT t2.fld010, t2.fld004 FROM tab02 AS t1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS t2 ON t1.fld002 = t2.fld002 WHERE t1.fld043 = 'Kevin Constant' ORDER BY t2.fld010 DESC) ORDER BY fld004 DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT `date` FROM ( SELECT t2.crossing, t2.`date` FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_fifa_api_id = t2.player_fifa_api_id WHERE t1.player_name = 'Kevin Constant' ORDER BY t2.crossing DESC) ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1
